title: Ant milks aphis.
html_source:
Aphids suck the sugar-rich fluids from their host plants…The aphids then excrete equally large quantities of waste, called honeydew, which is high in sugar content….Some ants are so hungry for the honeydew, they’ll actually “milk” the aphids to make them excrete it.
